neighbours.label: a loose extender after a list or a time ('and more', 'and such', 'and up to', 'ごろ', 'or so'), as opposed to the same sentences with an exact end
fire: For a hundred years and more, they ruled the coast.
During the rest of 1700 and up to his death he stayed.
They sell paper, pens and the like.
It took a week or so to finish.
We saw foxes, deer and whatnot in the woods.
She stayed for two years or thereabouts.
quiet: For a hundred years, they ruled the coast.
During the rest of 1700 he stayed at home.
It took a week to finish.
We saw foxes and deer in the woods.
